parts.text:
Native text is now observable **before the agent turn ends**, including the new progress message. The run also exposed a reconnect gap, so I’m keeping “in-turn observation” separate from “fresh token streaming.”

The browser can reach the local inspector directly. I’m wiring a scoped, capture-only relay next so evidence appears during capture rather than only after the window closes. Steering remains disabled in the inspector.

The inspector now has a separate **Native model evidence** panel. The scoped relay is running, and I’ve opened the inspector so you can watch it populate. It labels buffered text, incomplete projections and stale source status rather than presenting them as live certainty.
